The '''palace''' of the [[Sith King]] [[Hakagram Graush]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. The ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] mentioned the palace in her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hakagram Graush's palace was first mentioned in the resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
